variables_datatypes.objective: Understand variables, primitive data types (int, float, str, bool), and type conversion in Python.

operators_expressions.objective: Apply arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators to build and evaluate expressions.

strings.objective: Manipulate and format strings using indexing, slicing, and built-in string methods.

control_flow.objective: Use if / elif / else statements to control the flow of a program based on conditions.

loops.objective: Use for and while loops to repeat operations over sequences and conditions.

lists_tuples.objective: Store and manipulate ordered collections of data using lists and tuples.

dictionaries_sets.objective: Store and manipulate key-value pairs and unique-element collections using dicts and sets.

functions.objective: Define reusable functions with parameters, return values, and default arguments.

scope_recursion.objective: Understand variable scope (local vs. global) and write simple recursive functions.

exceptions.objective: Handle runtime errors gracefully using try / except / finally blocks.

file_io.objective: Read from and write to text files safely using context managers.

oop_basics.objective: Define classes, instantiate objects, and use basic single inheritance.
